module: Node "Generate License Plate" (category `once_instant`, tags plate/license). Generates a random license plate for a vehicle: `core_vehicles.regenerateVehicleLicenseText(veh)` then `core_vehicles.setPlateText(text, vehId)`. Input pin: `vehId` (default: player).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

workOnce.desc: Generates a random plate text and applies it to the vehicle.
